blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Drivers call the office all day long. They call for help. They call for information. They call to ask for permission.

On the phone, we use small words like "can" and "could". "Can I help you?" is a warm way to answer a call. "Could you repeat, please?" is a polite way to ask again. "Could" sounds more polite than "can".

These small words open all the doors — and all the gates. Politeness on the phone is worth gold. It builds trust, and it stops big misunderstandings before they start.

items.q: Why do drivers call the office?
items.why: "They call for help. They call for information. They call to ask for permission."

items.q: Which word sounds more polite?
items.why: "'Could' sounds more polite than 'can'."

items.q: "Can I help you?" is used to…
options: answer the call in a warm way
items.why: "'Can I help you?' is a warm way to answer a call."

items.q: The text suggests that small words on the phone are…
items.why: Inferência: "Politeness on the phone is worth gold" — mostra que essas pequenas palavras têm muito valor.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: drivers should not call the office
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que a educação "builds trust" e evita mal-entendidos.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver atendendo as ligações dos motoristas no escritório. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, this is Oliver. My phone rings all day long, and I like it that way. Every call is a driver who needs something.

A driver calls. "Can I help you?" I say. He needs the gate code for the north depot. I give it to him, and I ask him to repeat the numbers back to me. That way, I know he has it right.

Another call. A driver is late and worried. "Could you hold for a moment?" I ask. I check the map, and I find a faster road for him. He says thank you, and I feel good.

Sometimes the line is bad, and I can't hear the driver. "Could you repeat, please?" I say. It is a small question, but it saves a lot of time.

If I am busy, I take a message. I write the name, the number, and the problem. Then I say, "I'll call you back in five minutes." And I always do. That is how you build trust on the phone.

Small words, big difference. That is my job, and I love it.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Oliver say when he answers a driver's call?
items.why: "'Can I help you?' I say."

items.q: Why does Oliver ask the driver to repeat the numbers?
options: Because he did not give them
To be sure the driver has them right
items.why: "That way, I know he has it right."

items.q: What does Oliver do when the line is bad?
items.why: "'Could you repeat, please?' I say."

items.q: When Oliver says "I'll call you back in five minutes," he always…
items.why: Inferência: "And I always do. That is how you build trust" — ele cumpre o que promete.

items.q: How does Oliver feel about his job?
options: He does not like the phone
items.why: Inferência: "My phone rings all day, and I like it that way… I love it."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I got a call from a driver this morning." A call is…
items.why: Call = ligação, uma conversa por telefone.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The driver needs ___ with the gate code."
items.why: Help = ajuda; o motorista precisa de ajuda com o código.

items.q: "I don't know the answer, so I will ask my manager." An answer is…
items.why: Answer = resposta; a reação a uma pergunta.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Oliver is busy, so he takes a ___ for him."
items.why: Message = mensagem/recado; ele anota o recado.

items.q: "There is a problem with the truck, so the driver called." A problem is…
items.why: Problem = problema; algo que está errado.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem em ligações de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I'll call you back in five minutes." To call back means to…
items.why: Call back = ligar de volta, telefonar de novo mais tarde.

items.q: "Could you hold on for a moment?" To hold on means to…
items.why: Hold on = aguardar na linha, esperar um momento.

items.q: "Can you pick up the phone, please?" To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = atender o telefone.

items.q: "Please take a message if I am busy." To take a message means to…
options: write down what the caller says
items.why: Take a message = anotar o recado para a pessoa depois.

items.q: "The driver said goodbye and hung up." To hang up means to…
items.why: Hang up = desligar o telefone, encerrar a ligação.
